analysis:
PORTFOLIO REVIEW: Market is in a confirmed uptrend (+2.0% vs SMA50, positive slope) but the book is already over-deployed at 84% with 6 positions — above the 3-5 concentrated target. Historical metrics are a clear warning: 25% win rate, 0.15x profit factor, and a -2.35 Sortino ratio all signal that forcing trades has destroyed value. The mandate is capital preservation and discipline, not activity.

POSITION-BY-POSITION: AMP (+3.97%) and MCO (+9.29%) are performing well; thesis intact, hold. ROP (+2.64%) and SYK (+0.48%) are grinding slowly — no thesis break but watch for stall. IDXX (-0.63%) is essentially flat and tying up ~14% of equity in a sideways drift; if it fails to resolve upward within 4-6 weeks, it becomes a capital-efficiency problem. LMT (-2.68%) is the most concerning — this is a re-entry after the prior LMT was stopped out at +2.06%, and the position is already underwater. Defense spending uncertainty and the pattern of a failed re-entry warrant close monitoring; exit on any close below the entry average less 7-8% (~$540).

NEW TRADE LOGIC: With only ~$11,085 of headroom, new sizing is constrained to roughly 10% of equity — not ideal for concentration, but still worth acting on IF the setup is genuinely asymmetric. Of all 30 screened candidates, NVDA stands alone on the quality dimension: 105.9% revenue growth, 66.2% op margins, $41.8B FCF, $134B operating cash flow, +20.4% EPS revision tailwind, PEG 0.63, and AI infrastructure demand that is durable over years. Technically, it sits at 75% of its 52-week range with only +4.4% above SMA50 (not extended), confirmed uptrend, and the SMA50 slope is still rising. This is acceptable entry territory for a LTCG hold. No other candidate combines this quality with this setup quality — I am not proposing trades in HOOD (D/E 240, speculative), ZBRA (86% range, SMA50 slope +19.5% = extended), SCHW (88% range, extended), or IT (+25.9% above SMA50 = extended). One measured NVDA position is the only trade that clears the bar today.

trades.entry_strategy: Limit at $217.55 or better; accept up to $220 on strength. Prefer a 1-2 day pullback toward $214-216 to improve entry. Do not chase above $222.
trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: NVDA is the clearest example of a dominant-moat business in a secular growth wave. Revenue +105.9% YoY, operating margin 66.2%, FCF $41.8B, and EPS revisions +20.4% in the last 60 days all point to an accelerating, not slowing, earnings cycle driven by AI infrastructure spend. PEG of 0.63 and fwd P/E of 14.21 make this arguably cheap relative to growth once you discount the AI capex cycle. TECHNICAL: Price is at 75% of 52-week range — not at an extreme. At only +4.4% above SMA50 with the SMA50 slope still in mild positive territory (+1.1%), this is a basing UPTREND entry, not a late-cycle chase. Stop at 1.75x ATR14 ($6.96) = $205.37, a 5.6% drawdown. Sizing constrained to ~51 shares by the $11,085 headroom cap, risking $621 (0.6% of equity) — well within the 1-2% heat rule. Intend to hold past 12 months for LTCG tax treatment if thesis remains intact.
trades.exit_plan: Stop at $205.37 (1.75x ATR, hard rule). Thesis-break exit: if quarterly revenue growth drops below 40% for two consecutive quarters OR operating margins compress below 55%, reassess and likely exit regardless of price. Time stop: reassess after 6 months if price has not moved toward $240+. Near 52w high ($235.47) may see temporary resistance — do not exit there, trim only if position has grown to >20% of equity. Hold past 1-year mark if trajectory is intact to capture LTCG rate. Earnings are 78 days out (Nov 17) — no position adjustment needed before then unless stop is hit.
